{{Quote|I heard the Kronapuff's ancestors were super, super, super [[Kronaclaw|powerful raptors]] that lived in the frostlands! And now they're like… this.}}
A native bird of Lahai-Roi, originated from the [[Kronaclaw]], they are clumsy fliers and "bird brained".<ref>[[Levona]]</ref> They once roamed the Roya Frostlands as a predator raptor until the First Epoch had reduced their numbers to near extinctions. With no predators and plenty of food, these former predators slowly changed to that of the current Kronapuff. 

Few Kronaclaw roams the Roya Frostlands, with many of thier population replaced with an Exoswarms imitation.<ref>[[Kronablight]]</ref>

Due to their very round anatomy, they cannot easily fly and are easy preyed.<ref>*[[Science Gone Mad I]]</ref> They are also used in cuisine for their fat meat,<ref>[[Smoked Meat Stew]]</ref> though, many Royan's have adopted them as pets.
